nodes.description: Public totalSupply of the ERC20 token, set once in the UBYToken constructor.
Public token symbol string, hard-coded to "UB" in the constructor.
Public token name string, hard-coded to "Ucoin UBY" in the constructor.
Public decimals value, set to 18 in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances; read in balanceOf and written in transfer/transferFrom/constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowance table; written in approve, read and debited in transferFrom.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): multiplies with overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): division asserting b > 0.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): subtraction asserting b <= a.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): addition asserting no overflow.
UBYToken constructor: initializes metadata, mints totalSupply to msg.sender.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint256 tokens) guarded by onlyPayloadSize(2*32); moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to'.
approve(address spender, uint256 tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokens) guarded by onlyPayloadSize(3*32); debits balance and allowance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts; contract rejects ETH.
onlyPayloadSize(uint size) modifier asserting msg.data.length == size + 4; guards transfer and transferFrom.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance spender and constructor recipient.
Multiplication c = a * b inside SafeMath.mul followed by assert(c / a == b).
Division a / b inside SafeMath.div guarded by assert(b > 0).
Subtraction a - b inside SafeMath.sub guarded by assert(b <= a).
Addition c = a + b inside SafeMath.add guarded by assert(c >= a).
Balances mutation in transfer: balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens) and balances[to].add(tokens), then event emission.
Allowance overwrite allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens in approve (classic approve race condition, no access check).
Multi-state mutation in transferFrom: balances[from].sub, allowed[from][msg.sender].sub and balances[to].add.
Plain arithmetic in constructor: totalSupply = 300000000 * 10**uint(decimals) without SafeMath.
